name: Thandeka Nkosi
bio:
Thandeka's journey into the world of motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science, she worked in corporate IT for several years. However, her passion for racing, ignited by watching Formula 1 races with her father, led her to seek a role where she could combine her technical skills with her love for motorsport. She believes a robust and secure IT infrastructure is crucial for optimizing team performance, from data analysis to communication. 

As IT Systems Manager, Thandeka is meticulous in ensuring the smooth operation of all IT systems. She is committed to implementing innovative solutions to enhance data security and streamline workflows, understanding that even the smallest technical glitch can have significant repercussions on the track. While currently developing her management capabilities, her keen eye for detail and unwavering focus make her a valuable asset to any motorsport team.

physical.description: Thandeka has a warm smile and a focused gaze, often seen with her brow furrowed in concentration.

quirks: Always carries a small toolkit in her bag, just in case.
Drinks Rooibos tea religiously, believing it enhances concentration.
Uses motorsport analogies to explain complex IT concepts.
